name: Hot Crane
tagline: Robust HOT crane for medium to heavy duty lifting up to 50 tonnes
description: Safe Build Engineering's HOT Cranes are manufactured with advanced technology and premium quality raw materials. Available in single and double girder with load capacities from 12 to 50 tonnes, operated by radio control or cable pendant with anti-corrosive finish and minimal maintenance.
features: Lifts medium and heavy goods up to 50 tonnes
One floor mounted and one structurally mounted rail
Available in single and double girder
Radio control or cable connected pendant operation
Trouble free operation with less maintenance

specs.Class of Duty: M5, M7, M8 as per IS 3177 / IS 807
specs.Crane Control: Pendant push buttons / Radio remote / Cabin with master control
specs.Drive System: Twin drive squirrel cage induction geared motors with fail safe brakes
specs.Power Supply: Trailing cables / drag chain / shrouded bus bars / cable reeling drum
